Game Overview

Red Ball Jumper puts players into a clicker experience centered on guide a bouncy red ball through a vibrant world, leaping from platform to platform of matching colors. Hone your reflexes and strategic timing to tackle escalating challenges in this thrilling and addictive adventure. Embrace the unpredictable fun as the pace quickens and each jump becomes more daring.
